instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: Error, Fault, Failure and the Failures Log

questions.question: A human mistake in the specification introduces...
questions.explanation: The human error creates a fault in the artefact; nothing fails until that fault runs.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطأ البشري يخلق عيباً في الأثر، ولا يفشل شيء حتى يُنفَّذ ذلك العيب.

questions.question: When faulty code executes it produces...
options: a cost overrun here again again
an error state inside the system
a new requirement now here here here
a design document too now too
options_en: a cost overrun here again again
an error state inside the system
a new requirement now here here here
a design document too now too
questions.explanation: Execution of a fault leaves the internal state incorrect, which is the error state.
questions.explanation_ar: تنفيذ العيب يترك الحالة الداخلية غير صحيحة، وهذه هي حالة الخطأ.

questions.question: An incorrect internal state becomes visible to the user as...
questions.question_ar: الحالة الداخلية غير الصحيحة تصبح مرئية للمستخدم كـ...
options: a fault in the code now
options_en: a fault in the code now
questions.explanation: Failure is the observable deviation at the system boundary, the last link in the chain.
questions.explanation_ar: الفشل هو الانحراف الملاحظ عند حدود النظام، وهو آخر حلقة في السلسلة.

questions.question: How do defect and fault relate in software-process usage?
questions.question_ar: كيف يرتبط العيب والخلل في استخدام عملية البرمجيات؟
options: defect is a later stage than fault
they are synonyms here now too
options_en: defect is a later stage than fault
they are synonyms here now too
questions.explanation: Pressman notes that defect and fault are used as synonyms, not as separate stages.
questions.explanation_ar: برسمان يذكر أن العيب والخلل يُستخدمان مترادفين لا كمرحلتين منفصلتين.

questions.question: What caused the Patriot missile failure?
options: a clock drift from truncating one tenth
a stack overflow in the guidance loop here
a division by zero in the radar now
a memory leak in the display here too
options_ar: طفح مكدس في حلقة التوجيه أيضاً
قسمة على صفر في الرادار الآن
options_en: a clock drift from truncating one tenth
a stack overflow in the guidance loop here
a division by zero in the radar now
a memory leak in the display here too
questions.explanation: A tenth was truncated in the counter, so the clock drifted and the range gate shifted.
questions.explanation_ar: قُطع العُشر في العدّاد، فانحرفت الساعة وتزحزحت بوابة المدى.

questions.question: What caused the Ariane-5 failure?
options: a wrong launch trajectory now here too
a power supply failure here too now
options_ar: مسار إطلاق خاطئ هنا أيضاً الآن
طفح عند التحويل من 64 إلى 16 بت
فشل في مصدر الطاقة الآن مجدداً هنا
options_en: a wrong launch trajectory now here too
a power supply failure here too now
questions.explanation: The sideways velocity was converted to 16 bits and overflowed after 36.7 seconds.
questions.explanation_ar: حُوّلت السرعة الجانبية إلى 16 بت فطفحت بعد 36.7 ثانية.

questions.question: Into how many application domains is software grouped?
questions.question_ar: إلى كم مجال تطبيقي تُصنَّف البرمجيات؟
questions.explanation: The changing nature of software is shown through eight application domains in total.
questions.explanation_ar: الطبيعة المتغيرة للبرمجيات تُعرض عبر ثمانية مجالات تطبيقية.

questions.question: What does the evolving role of software mean?
options: software is only for experts here too
software reaches every aspect of life
options_ar: البرمجيات تبلغ كل جانب من الحياة
options_en: software is only for experts here too
software reaches every aspect of life
questions.explanation: Software moved from a calculator role into almost every domain of daily life.
questions.explanation_ar: انتقلت البرمجيات من دور الحاسبة إلى معظم مجالات الحياة اليومية.
